title: Scanned (image-only) PWS Appendix B building list for an ANG base janitorial contract: 21 printed rows with hand pen-and-ink amendment changes (one row lined out, one SF corrected, one row hand-added), UTA frequency codes and a stale printed total

sources.note: 168th Wing (Eielson AFB) janitorial services PWS, Attachment 7 to ITB 230000022: "Appendix B, Building Numbers and Estimated Square Footages" table of facility numbers, activities (e.g. MX Fab Shop, MX Hangar, Ops), estimated square footage and weekly frequency; price changes tied to the Appendix B "cleaning area" square footage. Copied: appendix title, column set, activity-abbreviation style, the B.1 modification wording (paraphrased) and the "floor plans provided separately (15 pages)" note.
State of Alaska ITB for the same 168th Wing janitorial services: floor plans for the facilities service areas and estimated square footage attached as a separate file.
Air Force custodial PWS whose Appendix B establishes facility cleaning levels and estimated square footage, with square footage totals used for modification pricing.
Federal RFQ amendment issued to provide per-building square footage (amendments that change the building list are the norm).

provenance.notes: Layout and wording follow the 168th Wing Appendix B (facility no. / activity / estimated sq ft / frequency, cleaning-area modification clause, separate floor plans) and Air Force custodial PWS appendices. Kestrel Air National Guard Base, solicitation W912KS-27-Q-0006, every facility number, activity, floor count, square footage, frequency, the amendment and the initials are illustrative. The page is rendered as an image-only scan (110 dpi grayscale, slight skew, speckle, scanner-edge shadow, staple mark, fax/scan header) so the PDF has no text layer.

inputs.out: W912KS-27-Q-0006 Att 3 PWS Appendix B Bldg List (conformed thru Amd 0001) - scan.pdf

traps: Image-only PDF: no text layer at all (rendered at 110 dpi, grayscale, ~0.5° skew, speckle noise, scanner-edge shadow, staple mark). The rule-based reader cannot read it; only an OCR / vision reader can.
Facility 141 FUELS MANAGEMENT OFFICE (1,240 SF) is lined out by hand with "DELETED – DEMO'D AMD 0001" and is excluded from truth.
Facility 160 TRAINING / CLASSROOM BUILDING: printed 10,350 is struck through and 11,020 is handwritten above it; truth is 11,020 (Amendment 0001 item b).
Facility 185 SMALL ARMS RANGE CLASSROOM, 1 floor, 1,320 SF, 1X/WK is handwritten into a blank row and is included (Amendment 0001 item c).

The printed TOTAL ESTIMATED CLEANING AREA (129,545) predates the pen-and-ink changes (it includes 141 and the old 160 value, not 185); the correct in-scope total is 130,295 SF. The TOTAL row is not a facility.
The table breaks across two pages (header repeated, "(continued on page B-2)"); scan/fax header lines, a CONFORMED COPY stamp and page labels B-1/B-2 are not data.
Frequency codes: 5X/WK → daily_5, 3X/WK → 3x_week, 2X/WK → 2x_week, 1X/WK → weekly, UTA (one drill weekend per month, B.2) → monthly; "1X/WK + UTA" (106) has no single service level in truth.

Square footage is the estimated cleaning area (e.g. hangar 125 office/latrine areas only, fire station admin only) — it is the only area given, so truth grossSqft is that number and no cleanable SF is set.
Asterisk after facility 125 name refers to a note below the table.
